example: Hello, I'm Ali. Nice to meet you.
exampleTr: Merhaba, ben Ali. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.

example: Hi, how are you today?
Hey, wait for me!
Bye, see you tomorrow!
We said goodbye at the station.
Can I have some water, please?
I want to thank my teacher.
Thanks for your help!
I am sorry, I am late.
Yes, I'd like a cup of tea.
No, thanks. I'm not hungry.
OK, let's go to the park.
Yeah, I really like this song.
Oh, I forgot my keys!
Welcome to our home!
tipTr: Teşekküre cevap "You're welcome" olur: "rica ederim". Tek başına "welcome" bu anlamda kullanılmaz.

example: What is your name?
Please write your surname here.
tipTr: Amerikan İngilizcesinde "last name" daha yaygındır.

example: Your jacket is very nice.
I'm fine, thanks. And you?
I don't feel well today.
tipTr: "good" sıfattır, "well" zarftır: "She sings well." ("She sings good" denmez.)

example: Dear Anna, thanks for your letter.
I want to be a doctor.
tipTr: Türkçedeki "-im, -sin, -dir" ekinin yerini "be" tutar: I am, you are, she is. "She happy" denmez, "She is happy" denir.

example: I'm a student in Ankara.
tipTr: "I" cümlenin neresinde olursa olsun büyük harfle yazılır.

example: Are you ready for the test?
tipTr: "you" hem "sen" hem "siz" demektir; tekil ve çoğul için aynıdır.

example: He's a teacher at my school.
tipTr: Türkçede tek bir "o" var; İngilizcede erkek için "he", kadın için "she", eşya ve hayvan için "it" kullanılır.

example: She's my best friend.
It's very cold today.
tipTr: Hava, saat ve mesafe cümlelerinde de özne "it" olur: "It's late." "It's cold."

example: We're in the same class.
They're my new neighbors.
Can you help me, please?
tipTr: Fiilden ve edattan sonra "I" değil "me" gelir: "with me", "for me".

example: I call him every day.
I like her new car.
Come with us to the park.
I see them at school every day.
My name is Elif.
What's your phone number?
His sister lives in London.
The cat is eating its food.
tipTr: "its" aitlik bildirir ve kesme işareti almaz; "it's" ise "it is" demektir.

example: Our house is near the school.
Their children are very funny.
Please tell us about yourself.
I want my own room.
tipTr: Fiil olarak "sahip olmak" demektir: "They own a hotel."

example: I'm not tired, I'm hungry.
One person is waiting outside.
tipTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: person → people.

example: I live with my parents.
I walk to school every day.
tipTr: Fiilin yalın hâlinden önce de "to" gelir: "I want to sleep." (Uyumak istiyorum.)

example: What do you want for dinner?
Who's that man at the door?
Where do you live?
When does the movie start?
Why are you so happy today?
Which bag is yours?
How do you go to work?
This is my brother, Emre.
Is that your car?
Can you close the door, please?
tipTr: Türkçede tam karşılığı yoktur; konuşanın ve dinleyenin bildiği şeyden önce gelir: "the door" = (bu, şu) kapı.

example: I eat an apple every day.
tipTr: Sesli harfle başlayan sesten önce "a" değil "an" gelir: "an apple", "an hour".

example: I have a lot of things to do.
I want something to drink.
There's nothing in the fridge.
tipTr: "nothing" zaten olumsuzdur: "I don't have nothing" denmez; "I have nothing" ya da "I don't have anything" denir.

example: Everything is ready for the party.
Do you need anything from the store?
exampleTr: Marketten bir şeye ihtiyacın var mı?
tipTr: Soruda ve olumsuz cümlede "something" yerine genellikle "anything" kullanılır.

example: Come here and sit with me.
Put the box over there.
tipTr: "There is / there are" "var" demektir: "There's a bank near here."

example: I have a brother and a sister.
exampleTr: Bir erkek kardeşim ve bir kız kardeşim var.

example: Do you want tea or coffee?
This bag is very heavy.
I like tea but I prefer coffee.
exampleTr: Çayı severim ama kahveyi tercih ederim.

example: I have two brothers and one sister.
exampleTr: İki erkek kardeşim ve bir kız kardeşim var.
tipTr: Türkçedeki "…im var" yapısı "I have …" ile kurulur: "I have a car." = Arabam var.

example: I have to go to work early.
I do the shopping on Saturday.
I can swim, but not very well.
I cannot find my phone.
tipTr: Konuşmada çoğunlukla "can't" denir; yazıda "cannot" bitişik yazılır.

example: Could you open the window, please?
You must stop at a red light.
You should drink more water.
The bus will be here soon.
I would like a glass of water.
tipTr: Kibar istekte "I want" yerine "I would like" (konuşmada "I'd like") kullanılır.

example: I want a new phone.
I need a new bag for school.
exampleTr: Okul için yeni bir çantaya ihtiyacım var.

example: I really like your new shoes.
tipTr: Edat olarak "gibi" demektir: "She looks like her mother." (Annesine benziyor.)

example: I love my family very much.
I hate waiting for the bus.
I prefer tea to coffee.
tipTr: Karşılaştırma "prefer A to B" şeklindedir.

example: Do you know her name?
tipTr: "know" hem "bilmek" hem "tanımak" demektir: "I know him." = Onu tanıyorum.

example: I think it's a good idea.
What does this word mean?
tipTr: Sıfat olarak "cimri, kaba" demektir: "Don't be mean."

example: Let me help you.
tipTr: Öneri için "let us" yerine "let's" denir: "Let's go!"

example: I have one brother.

The lesson is three hours long.

The store opens at five o'clock.
My son is six years old.
There are seven days in a week.
I sleep eight hours every night.
Our class starts at nine.
Wait ten minutes, please.
My daughter is eleven this year.
exampleTr: Kızım bu yıl on bir yaşında.

example: Lunch is at twelve o'clock.
Take bus number thirteen to the beach.
exampleTr: Plaja on üç numaralı otobüsle git.

example: My brother is fourteen years old.
The train leaves in fifteen minutes.
exampleTr: Tren on beş dakika sonra kalkıyor.

example: She's sixteen and goes to high school.
exampleTr: On altı yaşında ve liseye gidiyor.

example: There are seventeen students in my class.
My cousin turns eighteen today.
exampleTr: Kuzenim bugün on sekiz yaşına giriyor.

What is your phone number?

This jacket costs fifty dollars.
There are sixty minutes in an hour.
My grandfather is seventy years old.
About eighty people came to the party.
The movie is ninety minutes long.
The book costs one hundred lira.
tipTr: "hundred" sayıdan sonra çoğul almaz: "two hundred", "two hundreds" değil.

example: There are two thousand students here.
Over a million people live in this city.
exampleTr: Bu şehirde bir milyondan fazla insan yaşıyor.

example: This is my first day here.
We live on the third floor.
This is my fourth time in Paris.
Today is the fifth of May.
tipTr: Tarihte sıra sayısı kullanılır: "May 5" "May fifth" ya da "the fifth of May" diye okunur.

example: I'll be there in half an hour.
It's a quarter to six.
I go to the gym twice a week.
exampleTr: Haftada iki kez spor salonuna giderim.

example: I need a new pair of shoes.
exampleTr: Yeni bir çift ayakkabıya ihtiyacım var.
tipTr: Tek parça olsa da "a pair of" ile sayılır: "a pair of jeans", "a pair of glasses".

example: Children start school at the age of six.
I walk two miles every morning.
The pool is fifty meters long.
tipTr: İngiliz yazımı: metre.

example: What time is it now?
tipTr: Saati sormak için "What time is it?" denir; "How many hours?" süre sorar.

example: Have a nice day!
I see my parents every week.
We're moving next month.
I started this job last year.
The film lasts two hours.
tipTr: "hour" süre, "clock/watch" ise aletin adıdır.

example: Wait a minute, please.
Just a second, I am coming.
Wait a moment, please.
I drink coffee every morning.
I have a lesson this afternoon.
tipTr: in the morning / in the afternoon; ama 'at night'.

I sleep eight hours at night.
The train leaves at noon.
The party finished at midnight.
Today is my first day at work.
See you tomorrow at school.
I was very tired yesterday.
What are you doing tonight?
I am busy now.
The meeting starts at three o'clock.
tipTr: "o'clock" sadece tam saatlerde kullanılır: 3:15 için denmez.

example: I leave home at half past seven.
It is quarter past six.
We visit my parents at the weekend.
I start work on Monday.
tipTr: Günler İngilizcede her zaman büyük harfle yazılır.

example: We have English on Tuesday.
The shop is closed on Wednesday.
I see the doctor on Thursday.

February is a short month.
The course starts in March.
We moved here in April.
The weather is nice in May.
School finishes in June.
We go to the sea in July.
August is very hot here.
The new term begins in September.
October is my favorite month.
It rains a lot in November.
We have a holiday in December.
What is the date today?
My birthday is next week.
I bought a present for my sister.
tipTr: Sıfat olarak "mevcut, şimdiki" demektir; ABD'de hediye için "gift" de çok kullanılır.

example: She always drinks tea in the morning.
exampleTr: O sabahları her zaman çay içer.
tipTr: Sıklık zarfları genelde fiilden önce gelir: "she always drinks".

example: I never eat fast food.
tipTr: "never" olumsuzdur; cümlede ikinci bir "not" kullanılmaz.

example: Sometimes I walk to work.
We often go to the cinema.
I usually have coffee at nine.
Do you ever drink coffee at night?
I call my grandmother once a week.
Dinner will be ready soon.
I get up early on weekdays.
Sorry, I am late again.
I met her two years ago.
tipTr: "ago" süreden sonra gelir: "two days ago" (iki gün önce); "before two days" denmez.

example: Wash your hands before dinner.
We play football after school.
First eat your dinner, then watch TV.
exampleTr: Önce yemeğini ye, sonra televizyon izle.

example: The store is open until ten.
Please don't talk during the movie.
It's ten past four.
What are your plans for the future?
I will call you later.
I am still waiting for the bus.
tipTr: "still" süren bir durumu anlatır ve genelde fiilden önce gelir.

example: It's already ten o'clock.
tipTr: "already" beklenenden önce olan şeyler için kullanılır.

example: Is dinner ready yet?
tipTr: "yet" olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde, cümlenin sonunda kullanılır.

example: Can you say that again?
My family lives in Izmir.
My mother is a nurse.
My father works in a bank.
Mom, can I go out tonight?
exampleTr: Anne, bu akşam dışarı çıkabilir miyim?
tipTr: İngiliz İngilizcesinde "mum" denir.

example: My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
exampleTr: Babam pazar günleri akşam yemeği yapar.

example: Every parent wants a happy child.
exampleTr: Her ebeveyn mutlu bir çocuk ister.

example: My parents live in Ankara.
tipTr: Türkçedeki 'annem babam' için çoğul 'parents'; 'parent' ebeveynlerden biri demektir.

example: My brother is older than me.
tipTr: İngilizcede abi/kardeş ayrımı yoktur: büyük de küçük de "brother"; gerekirse "big brother" ya da "little brother" denir.

example: My little sister is five.
Their son is ten years old.
My daughter goes to primary school.
Every child needs love.
tipTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: child → children.

example: The kids are in the garden.
tipTr: "kid" günlük konuşmada "child" yerine kullanılır.

example: The baby is sleeping in her room.
The boy is playing football outside.
That girl is my cousin.
My grandmother makes great soup.
My grandfather reads the newspaper every day.
My grandparents live in a village.
My uncle works at a bank.
tipTr: İngilizcede amca, dayı ve enişte için tek kelime vardır: uncle.

example: My aunt lives next door.
My cousin is coming for dinner.
Her husband is a teacher.
His wife speaks three languages.
Many people work in this building.
tipTr: "people" çoğul fiil alır: "People are friendly here."

example: That man is my teacher.
tipTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: man → men.

example: The woman at the door is my aunt.
tipTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: woman → women ("vimin" gibi okunur).

example: I'm going to the movies with a friend.
He is my best friend from school.
Her boyfriend plays the guitar.
My girlfriend loves old films.
My partner and I live in Ankara.
The ticket is ten dollars for adults.
My son is a teenager now.
My brother is still young.
My grandfather is old, but he's very strong.
tipTr: Yaş sorarken de kullanılır: "How old are you?" = Kaç yaşındasın?

example: My sister is married with two children.
exampleTr: Ablam evli ve iki çocuğu var.
tipTr: Biriyle evlenmek "marry someone" ya da "get married to someone" olur; "marry with" denmez.

example: We have a guest tonight.
The museum has many visitors in summer.
Our neighbor has a big dog.
tipTr: İngiliz yazımı: neighbour.

example: Everybody likes our teacher.
Everyone in my class is friendly.
Somebody is at the door.
I need someone to help me.
exampleTr: Bana yardım edecek birine ihtiyacım var.

example: Nobody answered the phone.
tipTr: "nobody" olumsuzdur; yanında ikinci bir olumsuzluk kullanılmaz.

example: No one is at home now.
Does anyone have a pen?
She's a member of our team.
The food here is very good.
I buy fresh bread every morning.
There is no milk in the fridge.
tipTr: "milk" sayılamaz: "two milks" yerine "two glasses of milk".

He does not eat meat.

I would like a green salad.
Eat more fruit and vegetables.
exampleTr: Daha çok meyve ve sebze ye.
tipTr: "fruit" genelde sayılamaz kullanılır.

example: This vegetable soup is delicious.
She is eating a red apple.
I put a banana in my bag.
I drink orange juice every morning.
Cut the tomato into small pieces.
tipTr: Çoğulu "tomatoes" (-es eki).

Put some oil in the pan.
I like butter on my bread.

I cook dinner every evening.

example: My father loves cooking for the family.
exampleTr: Babam aile için yemek yapmayı çok sever.

exampleTr: Tuz eklemeden önce çorbanın tadına bak.

example: Add some milk to the coffee.
Cut the bread, please.
I am hungry after work.
tipTr: Türkçedeki gibi "I have hunger" denmez: "I am hungry".

example: The children are thirsty.
This cake is delicious.
This is my favorite Turkish dish.
We eat dinner at seven.
I drink my coffee without sugar.
We have breakfast at eight.
tipTr: "have breakfast" denir, "eat breakfast" daha az yaygındır.

example: Lunch is at half past twelve.
Dinner is ready, come to the table!
We have three meals a day.
Can I see the menu, please?
The waiter brought our drinks.
Could we have the bill, please?
tipTr: İngiltere'de "bill", ABD'de "check" denir.

example: Put the plate on the table.
This cup is very small.
I need a glass of water.
She bought a bottle of water.
Be careful with the knife.
I eat pasta with a fork.
Use a small spoon for the sugar.
exampleTr: Şeker için küçük bir kaşık kullan.

example: There is a good restaurant near here.
exampleTr: Buraya yakın iyi bir restoran var.

example: Let's meet at the cafe at four.

exampleTr: Ofisimin yakınında bir meyve suyu barı var.

I'm on a diet, so no cake for me.
exampleTr: Diyetteyim, o yüzden bana pasta yok.

example: Let's order a pizza tonight.
This present is for you.
tipTr: Süre için de kullanılır: "for two hours" = iki saat boyunca.

example: I go home at six.
tipTr: "Eve gitmek" "go home" olur; "go to home" denmez.

example: Our house has a big garden.
tipTr: "house" bina olarak evdir; "home" insanın yaşadığı yer, yuvasıdır.

example: We live in a small apartment.
tipTr: Türkçedeki "apartman" (bina) "apartment building"dir; "apartment" tek bir dairedir.

I take a hot bath after work.
exampleTr: İşten sonra sıcak bir banyo yaparım.

example: I take a shower every morning.
Where's the toilet, please?
tipTr: ABD'de yer sorarken "restroom" ya da "bathroom" demek daha kibardır.

example: The children play in the garden.
The kids are playing in the yard.
tipTr: ABD'de evin önündeki ya da arkasındaki bahçeye "yard" denir; İngiltere'de "garden".

example: Please shut the door.
Open the window, it is warm.
We live on the third floor.
tipTr: "floor" hem "zemin" hem "kat" demektir.

example: There is a picture on the wall.
I go up the stairs slowly.
tipTr: "stairs" genelde çoğul kullanılır.

tipTr: Duvar ve masa saati "clock", kol saati "watch" olur.

tipTr: Geçmiş zamanı düzensizdir: go → went.

My morning routine starts with coffee.
I'm very busy this week.

It's raining, so we're staying home.
exampleTr: Yağmur yağıyor, bu yüzden evde kalıyoruz.

example: I buy clothes at the weekend.

tipTr: İngiliz İngilizcesinde "pants" iç çamaşırı demektir; orada pantolon "trousers"tır.

exampleTr: Kış için yeni botlara ihtiyacım var.

tipTr: "glasses" çoğuldur; "a glasses" yanlıştır.

example: Put on your coat, it is cold.

exampleTr: Bunun benim bedenimde olanı var mı?

example: Show me the photos from your trip.
Try this soup, it is delicious.
Choose a color for the wall.
Can you carry this bag?
You can keep the book.
tipTr: "keep + -ing" "devam etmek" demektir: "Keep walking."

example: Please sit here, next to me.
I stand on the bus every morning.
Please sit down and wait.
Everyone stand up, please.
Please wait here for ten minutes.
Look at this photo.
tipTr: "look at" bakmak, "see" görmek, "watch" izlemektir.

example: Do not forget your keys.
I remember her name now.
I lie on the sofa after work.
tipTr: "Uzanmak" anlamında geçmişi "lay", "yalan söylemek" anlamında "lied" olur.

example: Let's meet at the station.
Can you help me, please?
I want to ask you something.
Tell me about your weekend.
tipTr: "tell" kişi ister ("tell me"), "say" istemez ("say something").

example: What did you say?
We talk on the phone every evening.
tipTr: Biriyle konuşmak: "talk to someone".

example: I will call you tonight.
We visit my grandmother on Sundays.
I look after my little brother.
Let me introduce my brother.
We discussed the plan at lunch.
tipTr: "discuss about" yanlıştır; "discuss something" denir.

example: Do you want to join us for dinner?
exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinde bize katılmak ister misin?

example: Could you explain that again?
tipTr: "explain me" yanlıştır; "explain to me" denir.

example: Can you describe the man?
I agree with you.
tipTr: "I am agree" yanlıştır; "I agree" doğrudur.

example: Can you give me some advice?
tipTr: "advice" sayılamaz: "an advice" yerine "a piece of advice" denir.

example: Let's have lunch together.
I send a message every morning.
I read a book every night before bed.
exampleTr: Her gece yatmadan önce kitap okurum.

example: Please write your name here.
tipTr: Geçmişi düzensizdir: write → wrote → written.

example: This magazine has a lot of young readers.
exampleTr: Bu derginin çok sayıda genç okuru var.

example: Reading is good for children.
I'm good at reading, but my writing isn't good.
exampleTr: Okumada iyiyim ama yazmada iyi değilim.

example: My grandmother tells us a story every night.
exampleTr: Büyükannem her gece bize bir hikâye anlatır.

example: I read an article about healthy food.
exampleTr: Sağlıklı yiyecekler hakkında bir yazı okudum.

example: She buys a magazine every month.
My father reads the newspaper online now.
The news starts at seven.
tipTr: "news" tekil kullanılır: "the news is", "are" değil.

example: Read the text and answer the questions.
tipTr: Fiil olarak "mesaj atmak" demektir: "Text me later."

example: What's the title of the book?
Open your book at page twelve.
Write a short description of your room.
exampleTr: Odanı kısaca anlatan bir yazı yaz.

example: Listen to the dialogue and repeat.
I had a nice conversation with my neighbor.
I need some information about the trains.
exampleTr: Trenler hakkında biraz bilgiye ihtiyacım var.
tipTr: Sayılamaz: "an information" ya da "informations" denmez; "some information" denir.

example: This movie is about a family in Paris.
exampleTr: Bu film Paris'teki bir aile hakkında.
tipTr: Sayıdan önce "yaklaşık" demektir: "about ten people".

example: That's a good idea!
In my opinion, the price is too high.
tipTr: "in my opinion" kalıbı kullanılır.

example: I can't believe it's Friday!
Guess how old he is.
Are you sure about the address?
We decided to stay at home.
tipTr: "decide to do" kalıbı kullanılır.

example: Maybe we can meet tomorrow.
He'll probably be late.
The hotel was cheap. However, it wasn't very clean.
exampleTr: Otel ucuzdu. Ancak çok temiz değildi.
tipTr: "however" genelde cümle başında virgülle kullanılır.

example: It's important to sleep well.
Is it possible to pay by card?
This isn't a real flower.
tipTr: "real" sıfat, "really" zarftır: "It's really good."

example: It's a fact: we need sleep.
exampleTr: Bu bir gerçek: uykuya ihtiyacımız var.
tipTr: "in fact" "aslında" demektir.

example: There's a reason for everything.
tipTr: "the reason for sth" ama "the reason why...".

example: I am late because of the traffic.
tipTr: Cümle bağlarken "because", isim önünde "because of" kullanılır.

example: We stayed home because of the rain.
tipTr: "because" cümleden önce, "because of" isimden önce gelir: "because it rained" / "because of the rain".

example: No problem, I can help you.
My teacher is always positive and happy.
exampleTr: Öğretmenim her zaman olumlu ve neşeli.

example: Don't be so negative about the test.
exampleTr: Sınav konusunda bu kadar olumsuz olma.

example: Imagine a house by the sea.
exampleTr: Deniz kenarında bir ev hayal et.

example: He even works on Sundays.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
Please fill out this form.
Fill the bottle with cold water.
Complete the sentences with one word.
Check your answers with a partner.
I wrote a shopping list.
I left a note on the fridge.
tipTr: İngiltere'de "kâğıt para" da demektir; ABD'de kâğıt paraya "bill" denir.

example: Please send me the details by email.
tipTr: "in detail" "ayrıntılı olarak" demektir.

example: Today's topic is food.
You must follow the rules here.
Draw a line under the new words.
exampleTr: Yeni kelimelerin altına bir çizgi çek.
tipTr: ABD'de kuyruğa da "line" denir: "wait in line". İngiltere'de "queue".

example: Look at the chart on page ten.
Read section two for homework.
Is this statement true or false?
exampleTr: Bu ifade doğru mu, yanlış mı?

example: Is it true that you're moving?
Read the sentences and write true or false.
exampleTr: Cümleleri okuyun ve doğru ya da yanlış yazın.

example: What are your plans for the weekend?
I prepare breakfast for my children.
Compare the two prices before you buy.
They're building a new school here.
You can create a new password here.
I like the design of your website.
I want to improve my English.
Does the price include breakfast?
What kind of books do you read?
tipTr: Sıfat olarak "nazik" demektir: "She's very kind."

example: This type of phone is very cheap.
tipTr: Fiil olarak "klavyeyle yazmak" demektir: "type a message".

example: This is the best part of the movie.
Can I have a piece of cake?
We work in groups of four.
Describe an object in your bag.
tipTr: Fiil olarak "itiraz etmek" demektir ve vurgu ikinci hecededir: ob-JECT.

example: Our houses are very similar.
My sister and I are very different.
tipTr: "-den farklı" "different from" ile kurulur: "different from me".

example: What's the difference between these two words?
exampleTr: Bu iki kelime arasındaki fark ne?
tipTr: "make a difference" "fark yaratmak" demektir.

example: We were born on the same day.
tipTr: Önünde "the" olur: "the same day".

example: The main street is very busy.
This is a very common problem.
Can I ask you a personal question?
exampleTr: Sana kişisel bir soru sorabilir miyim?

example: This app is very useful.
The final exam is in June.
Both my parents are teachers.
I only have ten minutes.
She also speaks German.
I just want some water.
I was born in Konya.
tipTr: "Doğmak" İngilizcede edilgen kurulur: "I was born in 1990." "I born" denmez.

example: City life is very busy.
tipTr: Çoğulu: life → lives.

example: He wants to become a teacher.
What happened at school today?
We are having a party on Saturday.
There's a big music event in the park.
exampleTr: Parkta büyük bir müzik etkinliği var.

example: We go to the summer festival every year.
I like action movies.
Swimming is my favorite activity on vacation.
I didn't understand the beginning of the movie.
My main interest is music.
The party was a big success.
We get the test results tomorrow.
This is a difficult situation for us.
exampleTr: Bu bizim için zor bir durum.

example: I love learning about other cultures.
I lived there for a short period.
tipTr: ABD'de cümle sonundaki noktaya da "period" denir.

example: This is the last bus tonight.
tipTr: "last week" "geçen hafta" demektir; "the last week" ise "son hafta" olur.

example: See you next week!
We rent a small flat in London.
tipTr: "flat" İngiliz İngilizcesidir; ABD'de "apartment" denir.

example: These trousers are very comfortable.
tipTr: "trousers" çoğuldur: "a pair of trousers" denir. ABD'de "pants" kullanılır.

example: The chemist is next to the bank.
tipTr: ABD'de "pharmacy" ya da "drugstore" denir.

example: There's a long queue at the bus stop.
exampleTr: Otobüs durağında uzun bir kuyruk var.
tipTr: ABD'de "line" denir: "wait in line".

example: We're on holiday in Antalya.
tipTr: İngiltere'de "on holiday", ABD'de "on vacation" denir.

example: In London, it rains a lot in autumn.
tipTr: ABD'de "fall" denir.

example: The shop assistant showed me two jackets.
exampleTr: Satış görevlisi bana iki ceket gösterdi.
tipTr: İngiliz İngilizcesidir; ABD'de "salesperson" ya da "clerk" denir.

example: Go straight on for two hundred meters.
tipTr: İngiliz İngilizcesidir; ABD'de "Go straight." denir.

example: I have a shower after work.
tipTr: İngiltere'de "have a shower", ABD'de "take a shower" denir.
